summary: Blue Moon Metals Inc. filed a Form 6-K to report that it had filed with Canadian securities regulators a NI 43‑101 technical report (feasibility study) on its Nussir project. The FS details a 13-year mine life, 24.98 Mt reserves at 0.99% CuEq, initial capex of $184M, after-tax NPV of $235M (8% discount) and IRR of 19.0% at long-term commodity prices. This is a routine reporting of a project update—no M&A, no change of control, no return of capital, and no board/management change event. The filing contains no transaction terms or special-situation mechanics. What to watch: Blue Moon’s progress toward a final investment decision.
